ticker_news.title: Netflix Earnings Open the Door to a Rebound With the Warner Deal in Sharp Focus
ticker_news.description: Netflix is set to report Q4 earnings after Tuesday's close amid scrutiny over its planned $83 billion all-cash acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The streaming giant hit revenue targets last quarter with $11.51 billion in sales and 317.2 million users, though EBITDA fell short. Investors will focus on advertising business growth, margin sustainability, and free cash flow generation. Netflix shares have fallen 15% since the deal announcement on December 5, though technical analysis suggests potential recovery toward $103-105 resistance levels.
ticker_news.author: Ali Merchant

ticker_news.title: 2 Undervalued, High-Quality Companies to Buy in 2026 and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms and Walt Disney are presented as undervalued stocks offering compelling value for long-term investors. Meta's highly profitable Family of Apps generates 49.9% operating margins despite investor concerns over AI spending and Reality Labs losses. Disney has recovered from its post-2019 box office slump with recent hits like Zootopia 2 and is trading at just 16.8x forward earnings with multiple growth catalysts including new theme parks and profitable streaming.
ticker_news.author: Daniel Foelber

SPY.title: Trump's 1-Year Mark: Two Country ETFs Crush S&P 500 By Nearly 90%
SPY.description: One year into Trump's presidency, Peru and South Korea's country ETFs have dramatically outperformed the S&P 500 by nearly 90 percentage points. Peru's rally was driven by surging commodity and precious metals prices (gold +75%, silver +210%, copper +33%), benefiting materials-heavy companies. South Korea's outperformance was fueled by AI-related semiconductor demand, with Samsung and SK Hynix accounting for 70% of gains. While the S&P 500 delivered solid but unspectacular returns, these emerging markets captured outsized gains through different macro themes.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
